title: Relativity-of-Price Value-Ordering Record -- RVO-1
description: A record of per-frame (market/venue/currency) value observations under an eventually-consistent, causally-ordered value model. Each observation is a local real-time price carrying a vector clock and a hash-chained receipt (the value-event clock). The cross-frame merge is a per-frame LWW-register CRDT (commutative/associative/idempotent) that converges to an eventually-consistent global view. consistency_scope must be local_realtime or eventual: immediate_global is REJECTED. Measurement, simulation and audit only.

consistency_scope.description: Scope of the consistency claim. A per-frame price is local_realtime; the global view is eventual. immediate_global is inadmissible (the relativity-of-value guard).

vclock.description: Vector clock: frame_id -> counter. Defines the causal (partial) order.

receipt_hash.description: Hash-chained receipt id (sha256:...), the value-event clock binding to the receipt spine.

scope.description: A per-frame observation is a local, real-time price.

declared_total_order.description: An OPTIONAL proposed linear order of receipt_hashes. If it linearizes two causally-concurrent events it is REJECTED (only a partial/causal order exists).

interpretation.description: Free-text interpretation. A single-global-price / global-simultaneity claim here is REJECTED.
